Section(s): REACTION MECHANISM AND DERIVATION OF THE KINETIC EQUATIONS; PARAMETER ESTIMATION

Text and equations in reading order:
    The equilibrium constants $ K_{1}^{*} $ and $ K_{3}^{*} $ are thermodynamically determined. The values were taken from Graaf et al. (1986):
(p5-5) \log_{10}k_{1}^{*}=\frac{3066}{T}-10.592    [code: algebraic, computes k_{1}^{*}, code proposes constitutive]
(p5-6) \log_{10}1/K_{3}^{*}=\frac{-2073}{T}+2.029    [code: algebraic, computes K_{3}^{*}, code proposes constitutive]
    The parameter values eventually obtained are given in Table 1. Since a reparametrisation was applied in the estimation, the numbers pertain to the formula
(p5-8) \kappa(i)=A^{*}(i)\mathrm{e x p}\biggl(-\frac{B(i)}{R}\biggl(\frac{1}{T_{\mathrm{a v}}}-\frac{1}{T}\biggr)\biggr)    [code: algebraic, computes ?, code proposes constitutive]
    in which $ T_{av} $ equals 501.57 K.
    which are introduced in
(3.1) r_{\mathrm{MeOH}}= \frac{k^{\prime}_{\mathrm{5a}}K^{\prime}_{2}K_{3}K_{4}K_{\mathrm{H}_{2}}p_{\mathrm{CO}_{2}}p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}}\left[1-(1/K^{*})\left(p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}}p_{\mathrm{CH}_{3}\mathrm{OH}}/p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}}^{3}p_{\mathrm{CO}_{2}}\right)\right]}{(1+(K_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}}/K_{8}K_{9}K_{\mathrm{H}_{2}})(p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}}/p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}})+\sqrt{K_{\mathrm{H}_{2}}p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}}}+K_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}}p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}})^{3}}    [code: algebraic, computes r_{MeOH}, code proposes constitutive]
(3.2) r_{\mathrm{RWGS}}= \frac{k^{\prime}_{1}p_{\mathrm{CO}_{2}}\left[1-K^{*}_{3}(p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}}p_{\mathrm{CO}}/p_{\mathrm{CO}_{2}}p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}})\right]}{(1+(K_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}}/K_{8}K_{9}K_{\mathrm{H}_{2}})(p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}}/p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}})+\sqrt{K_{\mathrm{H}_{2}}p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}}}+K_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}}p_{\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}})}    [code: algebraic, computes r_{RWGS}, code proposes constitutive]
    in which the pressures are expressed in bar and the reaction rates in mol/kgcat/s.

Symbols:
  k_{1}^{*}: Thermodynamic equilibrium constant for reaction 1. [-] (computed)
  T: Process temperature used in the equilibrium-constant relation. [K] (variable)
  K_{3}^{*}: Thermodynamic equilibrium constant for reaction 3. [-] (computed)
  \kappa: Temperature-adjusted value of parameter i in the reparameterized kinetic law. (computed)
  i: Index identifying the parameter whose temperature dependence is represented in the reparameterized law. [-] (computed)
  A^{*}: Fitted reference-temperature coefficient (prefactor) for parameter i in the reparameterization. (parameter)
  B: Temperature-dependence term representing E, −ΔH, or a combination of them. [J mol^-1] (parameter)
  R: Universal gas constant in the temperature-dependence exponent. [J mol^-1 K^-1] (parameter)
  T_{av}: Reference average temperature used in the parameter reparameterization. [K] (variable)
  r_{MeOH}: Net methanol synthesis reaction rate. (computed)
  k_{5a}^{\prime}: Rate constant for the methanol-synthesis rate law. (parameter)
  K_{2}^{\prime}: Equilibrium constant associated with step 2 of the mechanism. (parameter)
  K_{3}: Equilibrium constant associated with step 3 of the mechanism. (parameter)
  K_{4}: Equilibrium constant associated with step 4 of the mechanism. (parameter)
  K_{H_2}: Hydrogen adsorption equilibrium constant in the adsorption term of the rate law. [pressure^-1] (parameter)
  p_{CO_2}: Partial pressure of carbon dioxide. (variable)
  p_{H_2}: Partial pressure of hydrogen. (variable)
  K^{*}: Equilibrium constant for the methanol-synthesis reaction in the rate-law driving-force term. [pressure^-2] (parameter)
  p_{H_2O}: Partial pressure of water. (variable)
  p_{CH_3OH}: Partial pressure of methanol. (variable)
  K_{H_2O}: Water adsorption equilibrium constant in the kinetic rate law. (parameter)
  K_{8}: Kinetic constant appearing in the composite factor in the rate-law denominator. (parameter)
  K_{9}: Kinetic constant appearing in the composite factor in the rate-law denominator. (parameter)
  r_{RWGS}: RWGS reaction rate. (computed)
  k_{1}^{\prime}: Rate constant for the RWGS reaction. (parameter)
  p_{CO}: Partial pressure of carbon monoxide. (variable)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - CO₂ is the main source of carbon in methanol.
  - The concentrations of the different surface intermediates are in pseudo-steady state.

Laws: p5-5, p5-6, p5-8, 3.1, 3.2
